basic_info.description: Tucked in the heart of Mission Dolores, just steps from Dolores Park, 24th Street, and Castro Village, this stylish top-floor one-bedroom, one-bath condo blends classic charm with modern updates. Bright and inviting, it features hardwood floors and a beautifully remodeled eat-in kitchen with custom cabinetry, crema marble counters, subway tile, and stainless steel appliances. A drawer fridge and large 6 burner range and oven make cooking meals a breeze. Newly installed in unit vented full sized laundry means you don't have to walk downstairs. Enjoy the shared garden, deeded tandem parking for one car, low monthly HOA fee, and copious storage. With a pet-friendly building and an unbeatable location, this is the perfect place to call home!
